notes: The mechanic is a grant-budget component on the universe handle plus a legality-mask edge. An absent row means unbounded, which is what every save and every hand-built test world written before it carries, so nothing that worked stops working. The three constants also ship at values no run can reach, because the grid holds 300 nodes and only prerequisite-free ones in permitted cells are grantable. WORLD_SCHEMA_VERSION moved 4 to 5; sim-core's SNAPSHOT_VERSION did not move and no golden fixture diffs — goldens:regen was never run.

Measured in tools/w69 over four full 2400-tick runs per strategy: archivist sees action 8 masked for affordability on 4307 of 4804 ticks and for an empty candidate list on zero of them; denial-warden is closed by an empty list on 3508 ticks, having forbidden the grid; narrow-depth sees it legal on 76 percent of its ticks and asks zero times, because encourageResearch sits ahead of it and policyFor takes the first legal preference. Only uniform-random-legal ever grants, and it landed 1 grant from 234 submissions.

NOT A BALANCE CLAIM. release-plan.md forbids one before 0.5.0, and 0.5.0 is the release that builds the instrument rather than one that tunes the game. This file records what this build did on 2026-08-13 and nothing more.

The universe these vital signs describe is still degenerate, and in ways POOL_BUILD_LIMITS in packages/mc-harness/src/strategies.ts enumerates: action 14 is permanently masked in a single-universe run; ascension eligibility opens by passive worship accrual rather than by play; uniform-random-legal submits actions 1-7 with no parameter at all, because those carry no candidate slot list, so seven of its fifteen verbs are refused inside the dispatch and the noise floor is close to a passive control; and the reference scenario starts with zero favor, so every strategy is a passive control until regeneration pays for its cheapest move. To that list this revision adds a measured one: no strategy in the pool submits god action 8 at all, even at an unbounded budget, so the founding-grant verb is inert in every measurement this file contains.

Tolerances here are wide on purpose and are not comparable to the other two gates'. The standard-error estimator stratifies on cellIndex, and within a cell of this sweep the eight replicates are eight different strategies rather than eight samples of one — so what it calls noise is mostly strategy effect. That is the price of an instrument that can see a win condition.

Every record now carries terminalReason (contracts.md §1.1), and the summary carries countsByTerminalReason beside countsByStatus, so route share is measured rather than inferred from tick clustering. On the 32 runs behind this file: 12 ascensionApotheosis, 12 ascensionCanon, 3 stagnation, 5 still running at the cap. ascensionRate is 0.75 and remains far above contracts.md §7's declared 0.05-0.20 band — a finding, not a target, and W2 of the ascension-meta campaign is what changes it.
